metadata.purpose: Independent manually authored semantic oracle for a deterministic architecture simulation; all facts and source material are fictional.
metadata.not_evidence_of: Real model interpretation, attachment extraction, provider identity behavior, or live connector correctness.
metadata.schema_notes: Facts sharing a semantic key may gain additional provenance. Superseded facts remain historical; current answers must prefer an applicable explicit correction. Actions sharing an action key update one task, preserving parent lifecycle state. Oracle expectations must not be admitted before all supporting source parts are read. Every fact has supporting part_ids; every action has part_ids and supporting_fact_keys. Partial source processing may persist facts supported solely by already read parts.
